text:
```yaml
name: Version Uploads

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'feature/*'

jobs:
  upload-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload version
        run: |
          echo "Uploading version..."
          # Add your version upload logic here
          # For example, you can use a script or API call to upload the version
```
